title: Aureline M5 glossary-chip-or-card component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the glossary-chip-or-card family binds inside the frozen M5 learning-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-learning-component-matrix.schema.json). A glossary chip or card names where a definition comes from and how current its citation is so glossary prose never drifts away from cited source truth and never severs its canonical citation. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-learning is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
